blocks.text: ANTIPOLO — Bella Belen set a new career-high 35 points to lead Capital1 to the win column in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at Ynares Center Antipolo here. The Solar Spikers fended off Akari, 28-26, 22-25, 25-15, 23-25, 21-19, after saving six match points, with Belen drilling two clutch kills to improve their record to 1-1. Rookie Detdet Pepito also made key saves on Fifi Sharma’s last two attempts for the Chargers, paving the way for Belen’s end-game heroics.
